import pytest

def test_empty_data_with_maxcolwidths():
    from tabulate import tabulate
    
    # Test empty data with maxcolwidths - should not raise IndexError
    result = tabulate([], headers=["A", "B"], maxcolwidths=[10, 10])
    assert result == ""
    
    # Test empty data with maxcolwidths as int
    result = tabulate([], headers=["A", "B"], maxcolwidths=10)
    assert result == ""
    
    # Test empty data with maxheadercolwidths - should not raise IndexError
    result = tabulate([], headers=["A", "B"], maxheadercolwidths=[10, 10])
    assert result == ""
    
    # Test empty data with maxheadercolwidths as int
    result = tabulate([], headers=["A", "B"], maxheadercolwidths=10)
    assert result == ""
    
    # Test empty data with both maxcolwidths and maxheadercolwidths
    result = tabulate([], headers=["A", "B"], maxcolwidths=[10, 10], maxheadercolwidths=[10, 10])
    assert result == ""
    
    # Test empty data without headers with maxcolwidths
    result = tabulate([], maxcolwidths=[10, 10])
    assert result == ""
    
    # Test empty data without headers with maxheadercolwidths
    result = tabulate([], maxheadercolwidths=[10, 10])
    assert result == ""
